entries.name: ssh_hosts
entries.description: List the SSH hosts configured for this session, and optionally check that each is reachable. Raw OpenSSH targets (an ssh_config alias, user@hostname, or a bare hostname/IP) are accepted by ssh_exec, ssh_upload, and ssh_download without a configured entry.

check.description: Probe every configured host with a short non-interactive command and report reachability and latency. Defaults to false.

entries.name: ssh_exec
entries.description: Run a shell command on a remote host over SSH and return its exit code, stdout, and stderr. The command runs through the remote login shell; the connection is non-interactive, so it never prompts for a password or host-key confirmation.

host.description: Configured host name, ssh_config alias, user@hostname, or bare hostname/IP.

command.description: Command to run on the remote host through its login shell.

cwd.description: Remote directory to cd into before running the command; overrides the configured defaultCwd.

env.description: Environment variables exported before the command; keys must be valid POSIX names and values must be strings.

timeoutMs.description: Hard timeout for this call in milliseconds; defaults to the configured commandTimeoutMs. The command is killed when it expires.

pty.description: Allocate a remote pseudo-terminal for commands that need a TTY. Defaults to false.

stdin.description: Text written to the remote command standard input.

entries.name: ssh_upload
entries.description: Copy a local file or directory to a remote host over SSH (scp). The connection is non-interactive, so it never prompts for a password or host-key confirmation.

host.description: Configured host name, ssh_config alias, user@hostname, or bare hostname/IP.

localPath.description: Local source path, relative to the harness process working directory or absolute.

remotePath.description: Destination path on the remote host, interpreted by the remote side.

recursive.description: Transfer directories recursively. Defaults to false.

timeoutMs.description: Hard timeout for this transfer in milliseconds; defaults to the configured commandTimeoutMs. The transfer is killed when it expires.

entries.name: ssh_download
entries.description: Copy a file or directory from a remote host to the local machine over SSH (scp). The connection is non-interactive, so it never prompts for a password or host-key confirmation.

host.description: Configured host name, ssh_config alias, user@hostname, or bare hostname/IP.

localPath.description: Local destination path, relative to the harness process working directory or absolute.

remotePath.description: Source path on the remote host, interpreted by the remote side.

recursive.description: Transfer directories recursively. Defaults to false.

timeoutMs.description: Hard timeout for this transfer in milliseconds; defaults to the configured commandTimeoutMs. The transfer is killed when it expires.
